name: Asuku San
source:
The mysterious oneesan who possess a even more mysterious umbrella (rumour has it that it connects to the fourth dimension). Kind, caring and smart, San’s presence sweeps away worries and bad atmospheres alike. She is, however, very gluttonous; always seen eating…something out of her umbrella.

[From [url=http://whatistomato.wordpress.com/2011/01/24/itsuka-todoku-ano-sora-ni-review/]the Warum's review[/url].]

[spoiler]She received the name San when she became the head of the Asuku Family at 7 years old. Her original name was 晴 Teru.[/spoiler]
